date.description: ISO calendar date or date-time. A timestamp without an offset uses local time.

numeric.description: Auto can show words such as yesterday. Always uses a number.

sync.description: Refresh the visible wording as the clock crosses a formatting boundary.

threshold.description:
Display an absolute timestamp when the distance reaches this many seconds.
Omit to keep relative wording at any distance.

--ki-relative-time-font-family.description: Default body font family for ki-relative-time on a bare page.

component.description: Displays the elapsed or remaining time for a timestamp in the reader's language.
